# Draft:Nivritti Kumari Mewar

----
Nivritti Kumari Mewar is a Member of Royal Family of Mewar she married to Lakshyraj singh mewar of udiapur who is 77th custodian of mewar and vanshaj of Maharana Pratap. Nivritti Father was an active politician in state of Odisha and serving as an Deputy Chief minister of Odisha and his mother was also an current Member of parliament. She was also active involved in social activities specially related to women empowerment and child his husband and she have 3 child. his father-in-law Arvind Singh Mewar was 76th custodian of mewar .
